Disable iTRAK mover recovery on Energizing 5.0 - First Release ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Disable Recovery of Movers on Energize.When track is de-energized, the last known position of movers will not be saved and the movers will not be able to restart from that position in case of unscheduled stops.
Instruction Execution: -----
Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- Sts_ERR Enumeration: Value Description 1002 Device Handler faulted 1003 Device Handler is not in a supported state. Device Handler must be in state Available
Revision Notes: ----- 5.0.00 - First Release
